themes.name: daily aktivity
themes.prompt: You are editing a photobooth collage. Image 1 is the BASE TEMPLATE (do not change it). Image 2, Image 3, Image 4, Image 5 are 4 DIFFERENT user photos - each must go to a DIFFERENT position. CRITICAL: Every position must use a DIFFERENT photo. Do NOT repeat or duplicate the same photo in multiple positions. The template has exactly 4 photo positions: 1 cutout outside the frames + 3 framed photos inside. EXACT PLACEMENT (use a different image for each): POSITION 1 - The large character cutout on the LEFT SIDE outside all frames (cut-out silhouette style, no background): place the person from Image 2 here. POSITION 2 - Frame number 1 (the FIRST framed photo in the template): place the person from Image 3 here. POSITION 3 - Frame number 2 (the SECOND framed photo in the template): place the person from Image 4 here. POSITION 4 - Frame number 3 (the THIRD framed photo in the template): place the person from Image 5 here. FRAME RULES: Keep EXACTLY the same number of frames as in the template - do NOT add any new frames or duplicate existing frames. Each of the 3 frames must contain a different user photo. STYLE: Edit all 4 user photos to match the warm soft bright natural-light color grading of the base template. All photos must look visually consistent with each other and with the template aesthetic. BASE TEMPLATE PRESERVATION: Do NOT change layout, orientation, aspect ratio, decorations, text (sundate time, You get all my attention, cutie, no one heard a thing, Pretty Yujinie, My first and last), stickers, game console graphic, or frame positions. Keep everything except the people exactly as in Image 1. KEEP REALISTIC: All people must stay as realistic photographs - do NOT convert to cartoon or anime.
